content: Algorithms proposed in BIBREF23, BIBREF22, BIBREF26 to unsupervisedly learn linear mapping between two sets of embeddings are used here to align representations of source (training data) to those of target. We obtain the mapping generated by embeddings from one specific layer of pre-trained multi-BERT then we apply this mapping to transform the internal representations of multi-BERT while fine-tuning on training data.
